subtitle.en: The testament retold closer to classical style — Level 4 sibling of the free Level 2 story

title.en: From the Heart of the Testament

siblings.note: Original classical text — verify wording against a printed edition (e.g. al-Khatib al-Baghdadi's Tarikh Baghdad / manaqib literature) before authoring.

attribution.ar: إعادة صياغة بأسلوب أدبي لوصية الإمام أبي حنيفة (ت ١٥٠هـ) لتلميذه يوسف بن خالد السمتي. صيغت لهذا التطبيق مع الرجوع إلى مضمون الوصية المنقولة.
attribution.en: Literary retelling of Imam Abu Hanifa's (d. 150 AH) testament to his student Yusuf ibn Khalid al-Samti, written for this app; classical source consulted for content. Demonstrates the premium tier: same storyGroup as the free Level-2 package, richer syntax (hal, na't, sound plurals, Form III).
